description: An elderly man with a long white beard and white hair lies on a wooden cot under a white pillow, wrapped in a dark blanket, in a wood-paneled room. Armed men in dark 19th-century uniforms hold rifles upright around the bed, and a crowd of men in frock coats and top hats stands behind them, with a small table and papers at right. Light comes through tall windows at upper left. The style is an oil-like painting with no visible text, no frame, and no visible blood or wounds.
